name: 48192 · Wyandotte, MI
findings: ZIP 48192 (Wyandotte) has 67 nonprofit organizations. 24 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48192 (Wyandotte) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 48192 (Wyandotte) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 73% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 27 organizations here; 27% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
